Nina: Quick check 1 final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Pushed compact frames to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/qwerty/tri-mode-frames
Cal: Proposal: one shared subhead, three concise heroes. Hosted: 'Instant API to production LLMs' / Dedicated: 'Committed GPUs, predictable SLOs' / Private: 'Inference in your VPC, enterprise controls'.
Renee: Add a small benchmark CTA on Hosted: 'See benchmarks & slides' (gated) so we capture webinar interest.
Sam: Routing notes: Hosted -> self-serve signup; Dedicated -> book capacity scoping; Private -> request demo + security questionnaire. Each CTA needs unique UTM and CRM tag.
Nina: Microcopy: under Dedicated CTA add: 'Reserved capacity. SLA-backed.' For Private, show badges (SOC2, ISO27001, HSM) with links.
Cal: Legal: avoid hard pricing on hero. Use 'cost-optimized tiers' and show ranges in the pricing modal.
Renee: @launch-bot please create webinar invite for May 12 10:00 PT titled "Serving LLMs at Scale" and make gated slides audience.
launch-bot: calendar.create_invite: "Serving LLMs at Scale"  May 12 10:00 PT. Hosts: Renee, Nina. Link: https://meet.example/webinar. audience.create_segment: 'benchmark_clickers'.
Nina: Timeline: copy freeze Tue 5pm PT, dev handoff Wed 9am PT. Please review Figma by Tue noon. Thanks everyone :rocket:
